title: Retreat bu wéet bi
intro: Ci jaar-jaaru ngërëmu Yàlla, amna ruuh bu sell bu amul fenn, ñu tàqale ko ci seen askan ngir wër wéet ci yoon wu sell. Xamu ñu woon ni, tëj googu dina jur firnde ci àdduna yépp, di natt ngëm gu ñuy wax ba fàww.
clues: Laata may judd, dama daan liggéey ngir jaamu Yàlla.
Dañu ma yóbbu ci ndigalu yonent bu mag.
Dama doon dundal ci ay riz yu jóge ci Yàlla ba yéem sama walikat.
Ma génn ci sama njaboot dem ci barab bu féete ci penku.
Benn malaaka feeñu ma ci melokaanu nit ku mat sëkk, dima xamal doom ju sell.
Bima delloo ak sama doom juy sooga judd, sama askan tuumal ma, waaye doom ji wax ngir jàppale ma.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
